# LITUS Automobiles

> LITUS Automobiles sells Honda and Yamaha motorcycles and scooters in the Maldives, with genuine parts, servicing at LITUS service centres, and Shariah-compliant Ijara ownership plans that let customers pay monthly instead of buying outright.

All prices on the site are in Maldivian Rufiyaa (MVR). Promotions are time-limited and each one shows its end date, so check the live page before quoting a price or offer.

Contact: +960 779 7442 (phone and WhatsApp), sales@litusgroup.mv
Head office: Ma. Elysium, Buruzu Magu, Malé, Maldives
Opening hours: Sunday to Thursday, 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM

## Motorcycles and offers

- [Motorcycles](https://litusautomobiles.com/motorcycles): The full Honda and Yamaha range, with engine size, price and monthly Ijara estimates for each model.
- [Promotions](https://litusautomobiles.com/promotions): Live campaigns with the saving on each model and the date each offer ends.
- [Ijara ownership plans](https://litusautomobiles.com/ownership-plans): How the Shariah-compliant Ijara leasing plans work, the available terms, and what is needed to apply.

## Ownership and after-sales

- [Service centre](https://litusautomobiles.com/service-center): Servicing and maintenance at LITUS service centres, with online appointment booking.
- [Parts](https://litusautomobiles.com/parts): Genuine Honda and Yamaha parts, with an enquiry form for ordering.

## Company

- [Home](https://litusautomobiles.com/): Overview of the range, current campaigns and why customers choose LITUS.
- [About us](https://litusautomobiles.com/about-us): The company, the team and its showrooms.
- [Contact us](https://litusautomobiles.com/contact-us): Showroom and service centre locations, phone numbers and a contact form.
